findings.text: the new call sits inside `if sweep:` (the change gate over the crew-home token, set at recovery_watch.py:3422 as `home_token is None or token != home_token`), so on a quiet fleet whose token is unchanged the beat never reaches publish_obligations_on_beat — the exact condition the node's own recorded cause names; the repair is gated behind the trigger it was meant to replace.

publish_obligations_on_beat re-implements the sweep-start path already owned by the change-gate trigger (the _SWEEP_LOCAL.in_sweep guard, the non-blocking sweep_lock acquire, the daemon thread over _run_obligation_sweep) instead of factoring one owner both triggers extend.
